name: gotify-cloudflare
description: Gotify server (v3.1.1) ported to Cloudflare Workers and a SQLite Durable Object. Works with the official web UI and Android app.

GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS.description: The password of the first administrator (the user name comes from GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME, default "admin"). It is used only on first start, when no users exist. Without it no administrator is created and nobody can log in: there is no admin/admin default. Pick something long and unique, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -base64 24` (at most 72 bytes). It is ignored once users exist.
